description: Integration manifest for IDEs. Lists the installable engine builds (an always-installed base) plus an optional bundle catalog the user picks with checkboxes. The IDE copies the chosen engine's base on every install, then each selected bundle on top. Bundle membership is sourced from catalog.json; the build keeps the two consistent.

engines.summary: Manual QA team for Claude Code — base: test-lead + qa-engineer + schema-bootstrap agents, 11 core commands (author/update/audit/browser/routines/blueprint/results/next), kensa + core testing skills, Stop hook, bundled sequential-thinking MCP. Extra capabilities (analytics, platform knowledge, brainstorm, source connectors, automation) are optional bundles.
postInstall: Enable the plugin for the project (or fully restart Claude Code so it discovers the dropped folder).
Run /setup to bootstrap .tms/memory/ and wire any selected source-of-truth MCP servers.
verify: /help lists the base commands: setup, new-feature, update-feature, audit, run-routine, new-routine, blueprint, adapt-schema, save-memory, next, import-results
@ shows base agents: test-lead-agent, qa-engineer-agent, schema-bootstrap-agent

engines.summary: Manual QA team for Codex — base: project-scoped subagents (.codex/agents/*.toml), core kensa-* prompts, AGENTS.md operating manual, kensa + core testing skills, Stop hook. Analytics, platform knowledge, brainstorm, source connectors and automation ship as optional bundles.
postInstall: Codex auto-loads .codex/agents/*.toml as project-scoped subagents and concatenates AGENTS.md into its instructions.
verify: AGENTS.md, skills/, hooks/hooks.json are present at the project root

bundles.summary: Risk analysis, test plans, static spec review, traceability and deep base audit (6 read-only commands)
Web, mobile, API and security testing knowledge skills
Three strategists debate approaches in parallel and return 2-3 finalists (/brainstorm)
Write @KEN-tagged Playwright + TypeScript E2E tests — adds the automation-test-lead + automation-engineer agents, 10 framework skills and scaffold/de-flake commands
Wire automated tests into CI/CD — adds the automation-devops agent + CI runner/sharding/artifacts/gating/hygiene skills. Layer on top of an automation-<combo> bundle.
Review automated test code — adds the codereviewer agent + test-code-review/flakiness-governance skills. Layer on top of an automation-<combo> bundle.
Commit @KEN-tagged tests + keep .tms/ cases in sync — adds the git-operator agent + ken-traceability/case-test-sync skills. Layer on top of an automation-<combo> bundle.
Pull specs / acceptance criteria from Linear
Pull specs / acceptance criteria from Jira
Pull specs / flows from Figma (Dev Mode MCP)

notes.source: Paths are relative to the repository root. dist/<engine>/base and dist/<engine>/bundles/<id> are committed, self-contained builds produced by scripts/build.{ps1,sh} from catalog.json + shared/ + engines/<engine>/.
notes.copy: 'contents' means copy everything inside a source dir into the target (do not nest the source folder itself). For codex (target '.') that merges into the project root.
notes.base: engine.source is ALWAYS installed. bundles[] are optional and additive; the user selects them with checkboxes and can change the selection later. Unchecking everything installs base only.
notes.consistency: Every bundle id here has a matching entry in catalog.json (which drives the build). Keep them in sync.
